name: Eighth Brother's lightsaber
description: The Eighth Brother's lightsaber was a double-bladed spinning lightsaber wielded by the Jedi hunter known as the Eighth Brother, similar to other double-bladed spinning lightsabers wielded by Imperial Inquisitors, though it uniquely included a buzzsaw-like feature. It was destroyed by Kanan Jarrus on Malachor.
